artifact_observations.reasoning: The texture of the bread crust appears slightly overly smooth and plastic-like, lacking the fine, irregular crumb structure expected in high-resolution macro shots of real bread. The flour dusting looks somewhat uniform and 'sprayed' rather than naturally settled.

The layers of the rectangular cake in the background appear to merge slightly without clear definition between the sponge and filling/icing. The edges are soft and lack the sharp geometric precision usually seen in sliced cakes, suggesting minor generation blur or fusion.

The horizontal lines of the glass shelves show very slight waviness rather than being perfectly straight, which could indicate minor lens distortion simulation errors or AI warping, though it is subtle.
